integrity: Complete self-contained proof plus independent finite brute-force checks; no assumption that finite enumeration proves the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Scattered subsequences only; literal palindromes, q >= 2, k >= 1. Global priority not independently established. The greedy complete-alphabet arch criterion is established prior knowledge; new claim concerns reversal-constrained optimum, exhaustive optimal form, and cardinality.
title: Exact shortest palindromic subsequence-universal words over arbitrary alphabets
